description: User-defined basic cost objective (2026-10-16): 0.1*D1 + 0.05*D2 + 5*N + 0.01*Q cleaning/traceability + 0.01*Q wear. Zhou distances remain benchmark coordinate units.
price_basis: User-defined synthetic coefficients; no empirical currency or distance calibration
evaluation_period: one 780-minute optimization cycle; configured stock purchased once
pool_charge_definition: One-time synthetic acquisition cost 5*N; repeated use does not charge acquisition again. initial_pool_investment reports the same purchase amount and is not added again.
cleaning_charge_definition: One combined cleaning/traceability fee per container use; complete cycle recovery makes returned quantity equal issued quantity.
